- 9:00–9:45 AM: Intro + PM/wide-scope (Stephanie)

- 10:50–11:35 AM: Coding pair (Vivek)
- 11:45–12:30 PM: Culture/operational fit (Laura)

- Confirm you’ve reviewed the attached resume and the debrief template.

Thanks — I’ll issue calendar invites and a single Zoom link once we lock the order.

— Monica

Good start — two small suggestions:

- Move system design to after coding (candidates tend to do better with a warm-up). If we do that, we should allow an extra 10 minutes for system design (make it 60m) and shorten culture to 40m.
- Assign a rubric lead for each session; I can take culture + debrief lead. We should call out the rubric lead in the calendar invite so people know who’s collecting notes.

Also — Markus, are you able to shift to 11:45–12:45 if we move system design? If not, we’ll keep the original.

On a process note: can we use the Debrief_Template.docx (attached) and capture a short recommendation (Hire / No Hire / Needs Follow-up) per interviewer?

Thanks — that time works for me and I appreciate the single Zoom link. Two quick asks: 

- Can you confirm all times are PT? I’m in PDT (Seattle) and want to be sure.
- I’d like a 15-minute break after the coding exercise (I find I need a moment). You already show a candidate break at 12:35; would it be possible to move that to 11:35 instead so I have breathing room between coding and system design?

Thanks for coordinating. Resume attached again.

Best,
